data.name: WhatToDo
data.value: What do you want to do?
data.comment: Input prompt; a space follows it.

data.name: InstallClipboardToolLinux
data.value: Install xclip, xsel, or wl-clipboard to enable copying on Linux.

data.name: MenuExecute
data.comment: Must contain [x]; the key itself is not translated.

data.name: MenuEdit
data.comment: Must contain [e]; the key itself is not translated.

data.name: MenuExplain
data.comment: Must contain [p]; the key itself is not translated.

data.name: MenuCopy
data.comment: Must contain [c]; the key itself is not translated.

data.name: MenuRetry
data.comment: Must contain [r]; the key itself is not translated.

data.name: MenuQuit
data.comment: Must contain [q]; the key itself is not translated.

data.name: ListConjunction
data.comment: Joins the last two items of a list of config keys.

data.name: AzureMisconfiguredFormat
data.value: Azure provider misconfigured. Set {0} in {1}, or run 'shelly --config'.

data.name: ConfigParseWarningFormat
data.value: Warning: failed to parse {0}: {1}. Using defaults.

data.name: NoGraphicalSession
data.value: No graphical session detected (no WAYLAND_DISPLAY or DISPLAY). The clipboard isn't available over a headless/SSH session.

data.name: NoClipboardTool
data.value: No clipboard tool found. Install wl-clipboard (Wayland), xclip, or xsel.

data.name: HelpOptionInfo
data.value: Display the active configuration: provider, endpoint, model and shell.

data.name: HelpOptionTerminator
data.value: End option parsing; the rest is the prompt.

data.name: HelpPrompt
data.value: Command description. If omitted, you'll be prompted.

data.name: ResponseLanguage
data.comment: English name of this language, used in the model instruction 'Write your explanation in {language}.' Empty in the neutral (en-US) file.

data.name: HelpOptionConfig
data.value: Configure the provider and its settings interactively.

data.name: DefaultMarker
data.comment: Shown after the menu option that Enter picks.

data.name: ChooseFormat
data.comment: Menu prompt; {0} is the number Enter picks. A space follows it.

data.name: ConfigUnreadableFormat
data.value: {0} could not be parsed: {1}. Saving will replace it with the values entered here; the current file is backed up first.
data.comment: {0} is the config file path, {1} the JSON parser's message. Followed by ContinuePrompt and [y/N]; the y/n keys are fixed in every language.

data.name: ContinuePrompt
data.comment: Yes/no question; ' [y/N]' follows it. The y/n keys are fixed in every language.

data.name: ProviderOpenAICompatible
data.comment: A provider choice; ' (openai.com, llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, ...)' is appended.

data.name: SettingsHeader
data.value: Settings (Enter keeps the value in brackets):

data.name: InvalidPositiveInteger
data.value: Enter a whole number greater than 0.

data.name: InvalidHttpUrl
data.value: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://.

data.name: ApiKeyOptional
data.value: Optional: most self-hosted servers don't check a key.

data.name: SetUserVariablePromptFormat
data.value: Save {0} as a Windows user environment variable now?
data.comment: Windows only. {0} is an environment variable name. Yes/no question; ' [Y/n]' follows it.

data.name: UserVariableSavedFormat
data.value: Saved {0}. Terminals opened from now on will see it; ones already open won't.

data.name: ShellStartupLineFormat
data.value: Add this line to {0}, replacing {1} with your key, then open a new terminal:
data.comment: {0} is a startup file such as ~/.zshrc (or UnknownShellStartupFile), {1} the literal placeholder <your-key>. The shell line follows on its own line.

data.name: FishUniversalVariableFormat
data.value: Run this once, replacing {0} with your key. Fish remembers it across sessions, so no startup file is needed:
data.comment: {0} is the literal placeholder <your-key>. A fish 'set -Ux' line follows.

data.name: UnknownShellStartupFile
data.comment: Fills {0} of ShellStartupLineFormat when the shell is not recognized.

data.name: SaveChangesPrompt
data.comment: Yes/no question; ' [Y/n]' follows it. The y/n keys are fixed in every language.

data.name: ConfigBackedUpFormat
data.value: Backed up the previous file to {0}.

data.name: ConfigSaveFailedFormat
data.comment: Wrapped in ErrorFormat. {0} is the config file path, {1} the OS error message.

data.name: InteractiveTerminalRequired
data.comment: Wrapped in ErrorFormat. Keep '--config' as is.

data.name: DeprecatedEnvVarFormat
data.value: Warning: {0} is deprecated. Set {1} in {2} instead, or run 'shelly --config'.
data.comment: {0} is an environment variable, {1} a config key such as azure.endpoint, {2} the config file path. Keep 'shelly --config' as is.

data.name: MainMenuNeedsSetupFormat
data.comment: Shown in parentheses after the main menu's Configure option. {0} is a comma-separated list of config keys and environment variable names (untranslated).

data.name: MenuBackToMainMenu
data.comment: Last option (0) of the configuration wizard's provider menu when it was opened from the main menu.
